policy: Notice growth is frozen. Generic setToast is retired. Remaining sites are the N5 GlobalInterruption catalog; later PRs may only delete them or shrink the allowlist. Do not invent replacement UI to retire a Notice. PR-B removed N0 success notices. PR-C removed N1 internal notices after owner-side one-shot recovery. PR-D removed N2 user-action notices by reusing existing controls. PR-E moved N3 onto existing workspace-safety banners and closed the remaining interruptions as GlobalInterruption kinds.

classes.N0: Delete. Result is already visible or the user does not need to know.
classes.N1: Silent recover. Internal reliability; log only unless content becomes unsavable.
classes.N2: Reuse existing control behavior. Keep current state; do not add UI.
classes.N3: Workspace safety banner. Off Toast as of PR-E; locator/persist facts use existing workspace banners.
classes.N4: Irreversible confirmation. Not a Toast; listed for completeness.
classes.N5: Temporary allowlist. Keep until a designed surface exists. Do not invent UI in a cleanup PR.
